timing_flags.quote: We cannot verify data construction, look-ahead bias in SUE timing, or the treatment of delisting returns beyond the stated protocol, all of which could inflate the SUE signal.

selection_quote: The universe is point-in-time: firms removed from the index (e.g., distress or delisting) remain in the data through their removal month, including the return over that final month, which mitigates survivorship bias.
